نستجلي (form X)
# نَسْتَجْلِي (nastajlī) /nas.tad͡ʒ.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# نَسْتَجْلِيَ (nastajliya) /nas.tad͡ʒ.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
